final: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.station_mean) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.station_mean - o.overall_mean) AS mean_above_average FROM station_avgs s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.station_mean > o.overall_mean
